description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Retaliate: immediately after a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, the module offers your Reaction for an Opportunity Attack against it with your equipped melee weapon. Versatile Merc: after a Long Rest, set Expertise in one proficient skill on the sheet (by hand).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Retaliate Opportunity Attack offered by the module after a melee hit.
